about_the_game:
Dungeons & Dragons: Dragon Delves


Ten Adventures. Ten Legendary Dragons. One Epic Anthology.

Unleash the might of dragons in your campaign with Dragon Delves – a thrilling anthology of ten standalone adventures spanning levels 1 to 12, each featuring a unique and unforgettable dragon encounter.

This Fantasy Grounds VTT version includes:
  • Fully integrated adventures ready to run with dynamic line of sight, lighting, interactive maps, and support for both top-down 2D maps and 2.5D token view.
  • Built-in support for walls, lighting layers, and GM-only information, keeping secrets hidden until the time is right.
  • Drag-and-drop encounters, items, loot & XP, and NPCs for seamless prep and play.

What's Inside:

Each adventure is inspired by a different type of dragon, is beautifully rendered in a different art style, and includes a short dragon history, giving your players rich lore and unforgettable encounters:
  • Death at Sunset (Level 1 – Green Dragon): An ancient corruption stirs again in the forest.
  • Baker’s Dozen (Level 3 – Gold Dragon, Solo Adventure): A breadcrumb trail leads to a sugary prison.
  • The Will of Orcus (Level 4 – Silver Dragon): Uncover cult secrets in a defiled temple.
  • For Whom the Void Calls (Level 5 – Brass Dragon): A subterranean cry for help—and a deadly lair.
  • The Dragon of Najkir (Level 7 – Bronze Dragon, Solo Adventure): Rescue, redemption, and wreckage.
  • The Forbidden Vale (Level 9 – Red Dragon): Wildfires rage—and a dragon fans the flames.
  • Before the Storm (Level 10 – Black Dragon): Pirate betrayal, arcane gems, and a seaside siege.
  • Shivering Death (Level 11 – White Dragon): End a deadly heat wave from deep within the frost.
  • A Copper for a Song (Level 12 – Copper Dragon, Solo Adventure): Recover a lost magical melody.
  • Dragons of the Sandstone City (Level 12 – Blue Dragon): Clash with evil, guided by the hope of a good dragon’s egg.

Whether you're running a full campaign or dropping in a one-shot, Dragon Delves offers you everything you need to bring epic dragon adventures to life—optimized for Fantasy Grounds.

Pre-ordering this product will unlock a custom Dragonqueen dice set you can use within Fantasy Grounds. This will be available for customers after launch who did not pre-order as well, but you will get early access to it if you pre-order.
